## Neutral community model of taxonomic and functional communities

## Clear workspace and set directory

```{r setup}
rm(list=ls())
getwd()
setwd("~/GitHub/irrigation/Beta_diversity")
```

# Load packages

```{r}
require(phyloseq)
#remotes::install_github("DanielSprockett/reltools")
require(reltools)
require(ggplot2)
library(minpack.lm)
library(Hmisc)
library(stats4)
library(vegan)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(plyr)
library(MicEco)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Import taxonomic community data

```{r}
spp <- read.csv("./Neutral_community_model/Data/Species.count.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
design <- read.csv("./Neutral_community_model/Data/Metadata.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
design.irr <- subset(design, Irrigation == "irrigated")
design.unirr <- subset(design, Irrigation == "non-irrigated")

spp.irr1 <- spp[,rownames(design.irr)]
spp.unirr1 <- spp[,rownames(design.unirr)]

# Remove the extremely low taxa or genes that may occur accidentally
spp.irr <- spp.irr1[rowSums(spp.irr1) > 20,]
spp.unirr <- spp.unirr1[rowSums(spp.unirr1) > 20,]
```


# Perform Neutral Community Model analysis in Irrigated fields

```{r}
spp.out <- fit_sncm(t(spp.irr), pool = t(spp), taxon = NULL)
otu <- spp.out$predictions
fit <- spp.out$fitstats
fit
m <- fit[1]   # species immigration rate, m
r2 <- fit[4]  # the explained variation in the NCM
```


```{r}
### otu, an OTU-table with taxa as columns and samples as rows
res = neutral.fit(t(spp.irr))

# Classify the taxa on the basis of their distribution
out2 = mutate(otu, group = NA)         
out2$group[otu[,2]<otu[,4]]="lower"    # below threshold
out2$group[otu[,2]>otu[,5]]="upper"    # above threshold, deterministically distributed
out2$group[(otu[,2]>=otu[,4])&(otu[,2]<=otu[,5])]="middle"  # neutrally distributed

out2$group <- factor(out2$group, levels = c("lower", "middle", "upper"))
mycols<-c("orange", "gray60", "#008B8B")

theme_set(theme_bw())
p1 = ggplot() +
     geom_point(data = out2, aes(x=log(p), y=freq, color= group),size = 1.7)+
        scale_colour_manual(values = mycols) +
        annotate("text",x= -7, y=0.20,label=paste("m = ", round(m,3), sep=''), size=5)+
        annotate("text",x= -7, y=0.25,label=paste("R2 = ", round(r2,3), sep=''), size=5)
p1

p2 <- p1 +
  geom_line(data = otu, aes(x=log(p),y=freq.pred),size = 1,linetype = 1, color ="blue") +
  geom_line(data = otu, aes(x=log(p),y=pred.lwr),size = 0.8,linetype = 2, color ="blue") +
  geom_line(data = otu, aes(x=log(p),y=pred.upr),size = 0.8,linetype = 2, color ="blue") +
  xlab("log10(mean relative abundance)") + ylab("Occurrence frequency in irrigated")
p2

plot_theme = theme(panel.background=element_blank(),
                   panel.grid=element_blank(),
                   axis.line.x=element_line(size=.5, colour="black"),
                   axis.line.y=element_line(size=.5, colour="black"),
                   axis.ticks=element_line(color="black"),
                   axis.text=element_text(color="black", size=15),
                   legend.position="none",
                   legend.background=element_blank(),
                   legend.key=element_blank(),
                   legend.text= element_text(size=15),
                   text=element_text(family="sans", size=15))

p3 = p2 + plot_theme
p3

ggsave("./Neutral_community_model/Output/Neutral model of irrigated taxonomic community.pdf", p3, width = 6, height = 5)
```

#===========================Functional community===========================================
# Import functional community data

```{r}
spp <- read.csv("./Neutral_community_model/Data/KOs.count.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
design <- read.csv("./Neutral_community_model/Data/Metadata.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
design.irr <- subset(design, Irrigation == "irrigated")
design.unirr <- subset(design, Irrigation == "non-irrigated")

spp.irr1 <- spp[,rownames(design.irr)]
spp.unirr1 <- spp[,rownames(design.unirr)]

# Remove the extremely low taxa or genes that may occur accidentally;
# Due to the enormous number of genes—with gene abundance in a single sample reaching as high as 170,000—the threshold was set at 100
spp.irr <- spp.irr1[rowSums(spp.irr1) > 100,]
spp.unirr <- spp.unirr1[rowSums(spp.unirr1) > 100,]
```


# Perform Neutral Community Model analysis in Irrigated fields

```{r}
spp.out <- fit_sncm(t(spp.irr), pool = t(spp), taxon = NULL)
otu <- spp.out$predictions
fit <- spp.out$fitstats
fit
m <- fit[1]   # species immigration rate, m
r2 <- fit[4]  # the explained variation in the NCM
```


```{r}
### otu, an OTU-table with taxa as columns and samples as rows
res = neutral.fit(t(spp.irr))

# Classify the taxa on the basis of their distribution
out2 = mutate(otu, group = NA)         
out2$group[otu[,2]<otu[,4]]="lower"    # below threshold
out2$group[otu[,2]>otu[,5]]="upper"    # above threshold, deterministically distributed
out2$group[(otu[,2]>=otu[,4])&(otu[,2]<=otu[,5])]="middle"  # neutrally distributed

out2$group <- factor(out2$group, levels = c("lower", "middle", "upper"))
mycols<-c("orange", "gray60", "#008B8B")

theme_set(theme_bw())
p4 = ggplot() +
     geom_point(data = out2, aes(x=log(p), y=freq, color= group),size = 1.7)+
        scale_colour_manual(values = mycols) +
        annotate("text",x= -7, y=0.20,label=paste("m = ", round(m,3), sep=''), size=5)+
        annotate("text",x= -7, y=0.25,label=paste("R2 = ", round(r2,3), sep=''), size=5)
p4

p5 <- p4 +
  geom_line(data = otu, aes(x=log(p),y=freq.pred),size = 1,linetype = 1, color ="blue") +
  geom_line(data = otu, aes(x=log(p),y=pred.lwr),size = 0.8,linetype = 2, color ="blue") +
  geom_line(data = otu, aes(x=log(p),y=pred.upr),size = 0.8,linetype = 2, color ="blue") +
  xlab("log10(mean relative abundance)") + ylab("Occurrence frequency in irrigated")
p5

plot_theme = theme(panel.background=element_blank(),
                   panel.grid=element_blank(),
                   axis.line.x=element_line(size=.5, colour="black"),
                   axis.line.y=element_line(size=.5, colour="black"),
                   axis.ticks=element_line(color="black"),
                   axis.text=element_text(color="black", size=15),
                   legend.position="none",
                   legend.background=element_blank(),
                   legend.key=element_blank(),
                   legend.text= element_text(size=15),
                   text=element_text(family="sans", size=15))

p6 = p5 + plot_theme
p6

ggsave("./Neutral_community_model/Output/Neutral model of irrigated functional community.pdf", p6, width = 6, height = 5)
```
